journey.name: Recipe Detail - View and Cook
journey.description: Test Recipe Detail page: view ingredients and instructions sections, tap cook button which auto-deducts pantry items and navigates back

actions.action: Tap the "Home" tab at the bottom of the screen
Tap the first recipe card in the list
Verify the "Ingredients:" section is visible with a list of ingredients showing quantities and names
Verify the "Cooking Instructions:" section is visible with step-by-step instructions
Verify the "Got it! I'm cooking this" button is visible and enabled
Verify the "Delete Recipe" button is visible
Tap the "Got it! I'm cooking this" button
Verify the app navigates back to the Home screen
